wiki.title: Andrea Harrison
wiki.extract: Andrea Fletcher Harrison (née Fletcher; born September 20, 1963) is an American politician. She currently serves in the Maryland House of Delegates, representing district 24 in Prince George's County, Maryland. She previously served on the Prince George's County Council, representing district 5.
